name: Day After Tomorrow
description: Five sits on a Finsbury Park lawn. Body practice, not therapy or a breakup coach. Model: you cannot change what is already here; resistance keeps it energized; withdraw investment; sit as awareness; imagine the identity you would pick; only the day after tomorrow belongs to you. Dwell then mint STONE, COIN, BOWL, SEED, DAWN, then STAR. The NFT unlocks the next sit. Pin id equals objective title. Audio is a placeholder.

objectives.title: sit-still-stone
objectives.description: Still Stone: sit with what is already here. Do not argue with today.

objectives.title: sit-withdrawn-coin
objectives.description: Withdrawn Coin: bring attention back. Do not spend it on the thread.

objectives.title: sit-empty-bowl
objectives.description: Empty Bowl: sit as awareness, not as the story.

objectives.title: sit-chosen-seed
objectives.description: Chosen Seed: rehearse the identity you would pick.

objectives.title: sit-daybreak
objectives.description: Daybreak: today belongs to who you were. Later is yours.
